validation.method: Psychiatric/developmental historical cases removed; each promoted criterion revalidated for at least one explicit nonpsychiatric supporting comparator in the v0.2 historical evidence map. Criteria lacking nonpsychiatric support would be disabled; none of U01-U09/D01/E01/Q01/Q02/S01/R01/R02 failed this check.

DISTINCT_DISEASE.interpretation: Higher-confidence evidence does not support TRD as one distinct disease; biological findings remain quantitative, overlapping, heterogeneous, or post-resistance.

BIOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE_OR_ENDOTYPE.interpretation: MDD-wide biological endotypes now have stronger proof-of-concept support, including cross-domain and treatment-response subtypes, but they do not map cleanly onto global TRD membership; TRD-as-one-endotype remains unsupported.

DIMENSION_OR_SPECTRUM.interpretation: A graded resistance/severity/chronicity axis is well supported; the two-failure threshold is operational rather than a demonstrated natural discontinuity.

DISEASE_STAGE.interpretation: A stage-like component is supported, especially accumulated treatment failure and chronicity, but stage is not sufficient as a universal explanation.

TREATMENT_RESPONSE_STATE.interpretation: The strongest ontologically modest description is a treatment-response state; rigor depends on treatment adequacy, adherence and exclusion of pseudoresistance.

OPERATIONAL_CLINICAL_CATEGORY.interpretation: The operational category is strongly supported and has demonstrated clinical, treatment, regulatory and resource-allocation utility.
